---
name: Feature request
about: Something Madrona should do and does not
labels: enhancement
---

## The problem

What are you trying to do, and what stops you? Describe the work, not the
feature — the underlying task usually suggests a better solution than the one
we would have guessed.

## Who it affects

Which role, and how often. A registrar doing this daily and a director doing it
annually are different problems.

## How you handle it today

Workarounds are informative; sometimes the workaround is the right shape.

## Standards or compliance angle

If a procedure, accreditation requirement or reporting obligation drives this,
say which — it changes how the solution has to work.
